title: when a subtask is created/spawned underneath an agent, it should have a subtitle with RE36: Name of subtask, using haik…

items.content: Registry: persisted unique agent codes + AgentSummary plumbing (done, untested)
Review code-name + subtitle changes for bugs and regressions
Render code column + shared layout helper for hit-testing, update/add terminal tests, docs
Registry tests for agent code names
Spawned subtask agents get a Haiku-written subtitle shown as '<CODE>: <subtask name>'

summary: The subtask-subtitle feature is with rust-engineer #57 in the background; nothing is built or tested yet. The code-column UI work (rust-engineer #56) and the registry tests (tests #8) haven't reported back either.
